reviews.title: Great Service and On Time
reviews.text: We flew out of Minneapolis to Orlando. The pricing was the best to be found. The plane was on time, the in flight service was excellent. We met other people that were flying sun country and they seemed very happy. We would absolutely fly Sun Country again.
reviews.author: don38506

reviews.title: Good flight, until it landed at MSP
reviews.text: Flight from HRL to MSP on 12/30/23. Flight was good. However, all sorts of problems happened as soon as we landed at MSP. We sat on the tarmac and then the baggage claim took seemingly forever. All told, it was around 70 minutes after we landed before we get our baggage. Sun Country compounded the situation by confusing passengers when making an announcement that people needed to stop by the baggage office. What? We followed up with two separate employees who gave different answers on that point. While the flight and routing is great, there is a lot of room for improvement once they get a plane on the ground.
reviews.author: Christopher A

reviews.title: Terrible customer service!
reviews.text: Please do not use this airline if you want to arrive at your destination or have any sort of customer service. Because of a delayed flight, my son missed his connecting flight on a Monday. The plane was still at the gate, but they refused to open the door for him to get on. They told him they could get him out on Friday. He had to reroute and find another flight. Almost two weeks later and we are still fighting to get reimbursed. Minimum wait on the phone has been 2 hours. "Customer care" says they will follow up and call you back. Never get a call back. Terrible customer service!!
reviews.author: Susan K

reviews.title: HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE!
reviews.text: Arrived in time for flight! Chaos everywhere! Workers rude and yelling at people. One you girl with pig tails in picture was a loud mouth yelling at everyone!! We missed our flight because they sent us to 4 lines for a bag tag!!! Over 30 of us missed flight!!! Totally sun countrys fault!! They are not wanting to refund bit we will take them to court! We had to pay for not only the ticket and suitcase. But also for carry ons and seats!! They will be refunding!!! The girl was yelling and disrespecting everyone and then said we were being mean! Thats laughable! She dished it out and couldn’t handle it!
reviews.author: Tina R

reviews.title: DONT DO IT!!!
reviews.text: The absolute worst experience I have ever had. If I could rate this Zero I would. I will never even think twice about booking this airline again. I don’t care how cheap it is. Left us stranded in Mexico with no communication, and zero organization. Horrible.
reviews.author: Kain C

reviews.title: Cancellations and delsys
reviews.text: Horrible experience. Flight cancellations or huge delays. No communication. Overbook flights or book flights when they know they do not have pilots. Charges for carry on bags. The only positive is the flight attendants are very friendly. This was my last Sun Country flight unless they improve their service.
reviews.author: Cynthia H

reviews.title: Let See If They Believe in Service
reviews.text: I wrote this reply to their Central Baggage Resolution Team......My opinion this was not resolved.... "Thank you for the $121.68 for the damaged luggage. However we have concerns. Simply put, we now have to pay full price for luggage because of luggage you (Sun Country) destroyed yet rather than making us whole, you are subtracting $47.32 for depreciation.....A bag we have had for less then a year. So you are making us whole based on a depreciation schedule but we have to go buy a new bag at an inflationary price since that's the environment we are now living in. We request that you send us the amount which has been deducted, $47.32 We are not simply a line item on an accounting sheet but the valuable reason why this company exists."
reviews.author: Where's The Service

reviews.title: Horrible if flight is cancelled
reviews.text: Cancelled flight after 4 hours due to crew. Next flight 4 days later. Will refund, but not what I paid for this leg of the trip. Does not work with other airlines to get you on a flight. Had to purchase a flight for the next morning and spend the night in the airport. No crew member around. Was told through airport personnel to email them. Email can take up to 30 days to get an answer. When I called they said they do not cover the cost of another flight, even though we were told they would, especially since next flight was days later. They will give a refund of $20 for meals. Lol. In an airport. They did give me a $50 voucher for a future flight. I will not use because I won’t ever fly with them again
reviews.author: iluv2grammy

reviews.title: Lesson Learned
reviews.text: Poor communication, flight was delayed multiple times and then ultimately canceled. Following Day, more delays while stuck in a hot airplane. Customer service was extremely rude and had no desire to make it right with one of their customers.
reviews.author: JR.

reviews.title: Woof.
reviews.text: I'm a lifetime discount airline user and am well versed in the ups and downs of no frills travel.... and Sun Country just took the prize for worst experience within a budget. Flight was delayed twice on the initial night of departure, which I phrase that way because the next delay was until 1:30 the next day... when it was delayed twice more until 4:40pm. The first night Sun Country claimed the crew had timed out, which may be true, but that doesn't explain the subsequent day's delay. We ended up bailing on the trip, fearing getting stranded in similar fashion at our destination. Sun Country did offer us a $100 voucher for two passengers as compensation.... as if I'd be inclined to use them again or that somehow makes up for the money we lost on lodging. Slightly more generous they offered a $47 meal voucher for each of us, though notably the federal per diem rate for food in Columbus is $64.
reviews.author: Ken E

reviews.title: First Time flying Sun Country
reviews.text: We were pleased with Sun Country. Both flights left and arrived on time. The check in and boarding process was simple. And all airline personnel we encountered were friendly and helpful. Our baggage arrived as expected. The Boeing 737 was in good condition and clean. The seats are a bit cramped as anticipated but seemed better than what we have experienced on other budget airlines. We would fly Sun Country again.
reviews.author: jbrown157

reviews.title: Ultimate efficiency does not create good service
reviews.text: The staff I interacted with were polite and professional, but clearly overworked and very stressed. The booking process involved many extra fees for seating and baggage (you pay the same amount for a carry-on bag in the overhead bin as for a checked bag). We flew Sun country because it had service from our smaller local airport, which was very convenient. A couple months after booking, our conveniently-timed departure flight from the local airport turned in to a very inconvenient 2 AM departure booked on a shuttle bus. Communication about the shuttle bus pickup location, expectations for our arrival time, etc were communicated by an automated text message sent 2 hours before departure. Yikes. On the return trip, our flight (and numerous other flights) were delayed by hours because of "scheduled plane maintenance that took much longer than anticipated". This happened at the MSP airport, which is Sun Country's headquarters and main hub. We got lucky and still were able to fly within 4 hours, compared to other flights which we saw cancelled completely. A couple hours after we landed, we received future flight vouchers for $50 each, which doesn't even pay for the shuttle from our local airport to MSP. Later, we also received an email offering reimbursement for additional meal expenses, long after we had discarded the required itemized receipts from our extra food purchased during the delays. Throughout our experience, I noted that Sun Country baggage check in lines and gate agent lines were always the longest in the airport. This should tell you something. It's clear to me that Sun Country has adopted a philosophy of ultimate efficiency by hiring only the bare minimum numbers of staff and operating with as little margin as possible. When unforeseen circumstances happen, they have very few resources available to solve the issues. This is a huge bummer, because it used to be a reliable airline for travelers who wanted to fly cheaply without amenities. Now, it's apparently stretched itself too thin to be able to handle it's own service.
reviews.author: BringerOfTea

reviews.title: Stranding Passengers
reviews.text: Sun Country Airlines left its passengers stranded in CLT, NC. Next flight was not until four days later. This was the airlines fault due to crew, not weather. We had to find our own way home and spent a lot of money on another airline. If you fly with this airline on these one off flights be ready to be stranded and make sure you have enough room on a credit card to pay for other routes home. They will not reimburse you for any out of pocket expenses. I was once a big fan of this airline. Poor way to treat it's customers.
reviews.author: natebe2022

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: For our 800 pm departure we were sent to runway via shuttle bus around 725 pm. We were first told there were 2 passengers who needed to join our flight but that we had no confirmation where they were. About 25 minutes later we were told they were not coming and we would close the door and be on our way, but that we needed to wait for a piece of paper before we could leave. About 15 minutes later we were told the 2 passengers would be joining us later and we would need to wait for them. Flight attendant reviewed safety protocol and 2 passengers arrived and were seated. 5 minutes later flight attended ant repeated safety protocol. We waited another 10 minutes until we prepared for departure at 920 pm. Sun Country had flight from DFW to MSP departing at 800 pm and another one departing at 900 pm. It is baffling the 2 passengers we waited for were not added to second flight departing at 900 pm. I will never fly using Sun Country airlines again.
reviews.author: Curt K

reviews.title: HORRIBLE HORRIBLE
reviews.text: HORRIBLE HORRIBLE HORRIBLE SERVICE!!!!!!! And it’s NOT the flying staff it’s the RUDE RUDE employees at the front check in!!! Horrible attitude, they’re condescending and purposely MAKE you wait if they just don’t like you. If you treat them the way they treat you, THEY SNAP and IGNORE YOU. just THE WORST AIRLINE EVER!!!!! ITS ACTUALLY STOMACH WRENCHING HOW BAD THEY ARE!!! I came up to pay for my bad and due to me not knowing my zone, I gave her my seat number, she literally LAUGHED and gave me a dirty look laughing at my ‘stupidity’ adjust sUCH UGLY people. Not to mention how they MADE ME LOSE MY FLIGHT do to a bomb threat in LAX, they did NOT wait for the connecting flyers and BASICALLY MOCKED US for ‘MISSING OUR FLIGHT’ when it was OUT OF OUR HANDS!!! JUST A HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE!!! NEVER EVER AGAIN!!!!
reviews.author: Moniska R

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: We flew with them because of the cheap rates but by far the worst experience. Flight was delayed 4hr+ and we got no notification/ no one was there to give updates. Do NOT pay cheaper only to have your vacation ruined by delays and lack of assistance.
reviews.author: Maria G

reviews.title: Basically Spirit
reviews.text: I have flown Sun Country multiple times and this past trip was the last straw. Sun Country up-charges you for everything, staff are always unfriendly, and they have no leeway when it comes to accommodating travelers. My flight did not take off until 12:20 and boarded at 11:45. I arrived to the airport, already having checked in at 11:22, and was told I was late and that I was going to have to be put on standby for the next available flight. The original cost of my flight was $179 but after bag fees and selecting a seat, I paid over $400! They have no in-flight entertainment or food and beverage carts during flight. Might as well fly Spirit, at least they have friendly staff.
reviews.author: Annie E

reviews.title: Sun Country Airlines Cancun airport
reviews.text: I have flown with sun country before and this is the first time I have encountered mistreatment. The entire crew including the supervisor a short woman with glasses and a reflective vest were unwelcoming and seemed quite unhappy that there was a line formed already. From my experience most of the workers are bilingual but there was no communication a JORGE LUIS flung his arms directing us like animals to move backwards. There was no respect to the line already formed and the people waiting. It could have been done professionally some communication and a simple explanation as to why we had to move out of line and reform the line would maintain happy customers rather than the way it was handled. When finally directed to move back in to line Jorge Luis said you all should remember your spot n line. Unprofessional especially because everyone reacts differently to such situations it could have caused worse situations, unnecessary situations. Organization and communication was lacking.
reviews.author: Liz

reviews.title: Family vacation missed up because of sun country airlines
reviews.text: Never ever again book or fly with sun country airlines. We got boarding pass but one hour before the flight cancelled due to crew??? Within one hour cancelled before the boarding time (June 4 2023 with flight number SY 429 MSP to LAX) and missed up all connecting international flight we have been waiting for this vacation for 3 years, it’s not easy to get vacation from work that will fit our family’s schedule. This is very important flight family of 3 ticket and relatives already prepared all meetings with both aides and birthday of my daughter together with other relatives , expecting us of our arrival back home but because of sun country airlines very late cancellation advise we cannot get any more other flights to catch up with our connecting flight. our family sad and very emotional at this time. Very bad costumer service also.
reviews.author: Rocarho

reviews.title: scammers
reviews.text: I booked my trip to travel from Dallas, TX to Las Vegas, NV but I wasn't able to travel , I asked to get my money back, I wasn't Never return my money back
reviews.author: Escape487756

reviews.title: NYC Girls' Weekend Ruined by Sun Country
reviews.text: On June 3, my two friends and I were scheduled to fly out of MSP (Terminal 2) on Sun Country at 7:05am, arriving in Newark at 10:30am, for a quick girls' weekend in Manhattan (returning home June 5). We booked our flights in February and chose this past weekend to travel, celebrating the end of a school year--two of us are teachers. During our 95 mile drive to the airport, we received a text that our flight was delayed 7 hours and would be taking off at 2pm. We considered what to do and decided to go directly to the airport anyway to see if we could get on another flight. There wasn't another flight available through Sun Country. We were offered $100 voucher to put toward a future flight and a breakfast voucher (we did not receive the breakfast voucher). We were told to arrive back at Terminal 2 three hours before our flight. We decided to leave the airport to have breakfast (and waste time), returning at 11am. There weren't any Sun Country employees around and their area was completely dark. We waited along with at least 50 people for about an hour, when a Sun Country employee finally arrived. When she realized we'd all been waiting, she chastised us for being there, as if we should have known they wouldn't be there until noon. Were there hours posted somewhere? None of us saw anything. We finally checked in, went through security, and went to our gate. At about 12:55, we were told to prepare to begin boarding at 1:15. At 1:20, we were told the flight was being canceled because Newark couldn't accommodate our flight-- we had nowhere to land. We were informed we'd receive a full refund for our tickets (which I have yet to see) and then left standing at the gate, no additional assistance or options given. One of the gate agents then said over the loudspeaker multiple times, as everyone stood there trying to figure out what to do next, "It's not Sun Country's fault that we don't have a place to land. If you want to blame someone, call Newark Airport." Seriously? So rude. After trying to find flights on other airlines for that afternoon/evening, and seeing the high prices of booking at the last minute, we just couldn't afford it. We ended up driving back home that night, no girls trip and out all of the costs for two Broadway shows and a visit to One World Observatory, over $1000 total. We were able to get back all but a $100 for our hotel, which charged us a late cancelation penalty. We saved up, planned, and looked forward to this for months. We had about 48 hours to spend in NYC and we relied on Sun Country to get us there. The stress, disrespectful and unhelpful attitudes, and the loss of our time and money is something we won't easily forget. From what I saw this weekend, customers' time and money are of no concern to this company. Note: I have taken several Sun Country flights over the years and have had good experiences, even when computer systems went down, we were stuck in a tropical storm, etc. because we were treated with decency. This experience was terrible start to finish, and I am embarrassed for recommending Sun Country to my friends.
reviews.author: lovinmexico2017

reviews.title: Horrible Experience- Took one of my vacation days away from me! 😡
reviews.text: Terrible flight scheduling. Cancelled times on 3 occasions, with a final long Layover. I don't recommend. This will be my last time flying with Sun Country.
reviews.author: Hope B

reviews.title: Worst experience! Sun country cancelled flight as I was on my way to airport.
reviews.text: What is unprofessional and should have consequences? When sun country cancels your trip 3 hours before your flight, with no alternate flight options and just offers a refund? Called customer care and they would not reimburse for hotel and rental car that was already booked. Sun country offered nothing and I would avoid them if possible.
reviews.author: Khaled S

reviews.title: Incompetent staff
reviews.text: Yesterday I took a flight from Las Vegas to Dallas Fort Worth and arrival was 10:01 pm. We were sent to baggage claim at D15. We waited for over an hour and a half to then be told all of our luggage had been mistakenly sent to customs which was locked up for the night by the time they told us about it. Then we were told there was no one available to come and open up that area for us to retrieve bags. Medicine, keys, and some AMAZING Caribbean food was in my luggage and I was unable to get it so had to take a lift to a friend's house for the night. I have been traveling since I was a toddler overseas and throughout the United States as my parents are both military and I have never seen this level of incompetence anywhere! How can a domestic flights luggage be sent to an area reserved for international travel? Then to be told after waiting such a long time there was nothing that we could do and to come back tomorrow is unacceptable. I understand the airlines suffered during covid but everybody went through something it's not our problem that this happened but if customer service is going to be this way, people are going to start marking out certain airlines to NOT travel with. Furthermore, why is there a charge to use the overhead bins this has always been free it seems like airline industry wants to nickel and dime consumers but not provide anything additional? I am 6 ft tall and sitting in the seats on the Sun Country flight was extremely uncomfortable because my knees were pressed up against the seat in front of me all in the gentleman's back. You cram a million passengers in a flight so you can make money but where is our benefit to choose your airline? What makes matters worse is that the next day trying to call and get someone to deliver love you was met with great resistance. Multiple people did not even want to give a manager the phone in order to discuss this manner. It's like they're trying to hide this event from upper management knowing which is wrong because that's the only person that can get things done and fix. This was my first flight with Sun Country, what a horrible impression! Right now companies are being boycotted for terrible service. Will Sun Country be next?
reviews.author: Mrs. B

reviews.title: Theives.  Stole a whole planes luggage
reviews.text: After arriving late. They sent the whole planes luggage to a closed customs office. Then came out a hr later and said go fauck yourselves we will call you . Will you mail our luggage? No, go fauck yourself. Will you reimburse me for the hotel since I have to stay the night til they open in the morning? No, go fauck yourself. What about the lost wages from not making to work tomorrow since I live 5 hrs away and have to stay the night? Yep you guessed it...No, go fauck yourself.
reviews.author: Robbed of luggage

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: My son and I booked our trip out of MSP to go back home and visit. We drove three hours to Minneapolis to park, and get in line for them to announce our flight to Cincinnati had been canceled. WHILE IN LINE!! Best part was upon the ticket counter yelling this at us they also told us they would not help us at the counter at all and we needed to call the service dept. ARE YOU KIDDING ME!
reviews.author: Mommaofboysx2

reviews.title: Highway robbery
reviews.text: As a person who believes in "proper preparation", I purchased our flights early 2023 to visit Cancun in June. To my surprise, flights have DECREASED over $100 in price, and since I bought 3 tickets, I figured they could adjust the fee, and reimburse me the roughly $350.00 difference. Nope! They actually told me they would be charging ME a $39 "adjustment" per ticket, per flight. So ridiculous. They take advantage of their customers just like any other airline, and I cannot say they accommodations/customer service has ever been even close to 5 stars. Disappointed to say the least! ZERO stars for me.
reviews.author: Sarah W

reviews.title: Be careful in cancelling a flight as they may not pay you back what they promised
reviews.text: After multiple attempts to reach Sun Country Airlines customer service department, I'll need to communicate here. I purchased plane tickets back on February 6 on reservation L8Q58D to my daughters wedding in Arizona and on March 30 I was notified that they'd cancelled the flight and my only option to reschedule would be a day later, which wouldn't work for the wedding plans, I called and cancelled the flight with you folks and was told by an agent that I'd receive a full refund. It's now almost two full months later and still am waiting for the refund. I've tried to reach out multiple times with no response.
reviews.author: Glenn Hilton

reviews.title: Unpleasant Experience with Sun Country Airlines' Cancellation Policy - Dont Bundle
reviews.text: I'm writing to share my recent experience with Sun Country Airlines, an encounter that left me profoundly disappointed and frustrated. Two days before my trip, I got sick and had to cancel my trip to Florida. While I understand that cancellation policies are a necessity for businesses to run efficiently, I was dismayed by the lack of flexibility shown by Sun Country. They offered me a travel voucher for my flight cancellation, subtracting a $150 fee, which I accepted despite it seeming like a high cancelation fee. I must now book a flight within a year. However, the real bone of contention lies with the rental car I booked through them. Sun Country refused to issue a refund for the rental car since it was less than 2 days from departure, a policy that I find exorbitantly unfair and far from customer-friendly. I also contacted Avis, the rental car company, I discovered they would have only billed me upon car pick-up, indicating that my cancellation incurred no loss on their part. To add to my frustration, I found that the rental car pricing offered by Sun Country was more expensive than alternatives like Expedia or Kayak. It became evident that these other platforms provided better pricing and allowed for cancellation without charges. Reflecting on this experience, I regret my decision to bundle services with Sun Country Airlines. The lack of transparency, customer consideration, and higher costs was disheartening and left a bitter taste. From now on, I will refrain from bundling services with Sun Country Airline, a lesson learned at a steep price. I hope my experience is a cautionary tale for others who value customer service, transparency, and flexibility.
reviews.author: javajon

reviews.title: Was booked on a van…not a flight
reviews.text: I booked a round trip flight from Eau Claire to Seattle since Sun Country now says it has connecting flights. Going there was fine, coming back was disastrous. When I landed in MSP 10:30pm last night, I had a boarding pass leaving MSP at 12:30am. But I found out it actually wasn’t a flight, it was ground transportation back to EC. So I sat in the airport for 2 hours waiting on a van to drive me back to EC. Had I driven myself to MSP, I would have been home by midnight. When booking my reservations, I was given a flight # and had to even pick a seat on the airplane diagram and was issued a boarding pass for my “flight” home. I feel totally ripped off. Now that I’m aware of the facts, yes in tiny letters it mentions ground transport, but that was not obvious at all when I booked. So be very leery when you booking with Sun Country that even though you’re using an airlines, you may get stuck on a van. I called Sun Country and they refused to issue any kind of a refund. I will never use Sun Country again.
reviews.author: Cindy O

reviews.title: I wish I could give them a zero!!!
reviews.text: The worse experience ever DO NOT FLY WITH THEM they lost my car seats I called and was told if I didn’t find them in baggage claim I was told by a representative that I would be reimbursed if I purchased more since common sense would tell you I can’t ride around with two three year olds while they try to locate the car seats so I purchase car seats and of course I call for a reimbursement and am told they don’t reimburse they can find my car seats as if driving around for days with two three year olds and no car seats is an option saving in the flight means nothing if I have to pay an additional $140 for car seats WORSE EXPERIENCE EVER!!!
reviews.author: Tineya walker

reviews.title: Very pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: Booked a one-way with Sun Country - despite having never heard of them - due to an extraordinarily cheap price to finish the last legs of a long international flight. After reading reviews, I was a little bit worried. The flight was under $150 for one-way across the U.S., and came to just shy of $200 after adding a carry-on and a checked bag. Honestly very pleasantly surprised with the experience. Online check-in went fine without any issues - a relief compared to some other carriers. No issues with my personal item or carry-on, and my checked bags made it through no problem. You get what you pay for...no screenback TV's, no free snacks, but worth it for the cost. The free entertainment streamed to your phone was a good selection (and the first airline I've flown with Family Guy). Could've been route selection, but planes weren't very crowded. My impression is that if you aren't in a big hurry, and can manage a layover in MSP, Sun Country is a great way to go to save a few (read: lot) bucks
reviews.author: Matt

reviews.title: Do NOT pay for overhead bin space.
reviews.text: Paid $45 one-way for overhead bin space. Found out even if you don't pay for overhead bin space you can still use it. So DO NOT pay for overhead space as Sun Country can NOT guarantee you a spot even if you pay.
reviews.author: B D

reviews.title: Inept and incompetent at every level. You'd be happier walking to your destination.
reviews.text: I travel full-time. One flight with this company was unfortunately the absolute worst experience I've ever had. This doesn't feel like an isolated experience, every turn within the Sun Country eco-system is littered with incompetence and inefficiency 1) At the desk, everyone was clueless that I had a lay over 2) THEY LOST MY LUGGAGE 3) Getting in touch with management was the biggest waste of time. No one on the phone or on premise has the slightest clue of what was going on. 4) They sent me their trash voucher, like I would be stupid enough to put myself through their torture again. It wasn't hyperbole: You'd be happier walking across the country than using this company.
reviews.author: Michael P

reviews.title: Mrs. Sherzoy
reviews.text: Terrible airline. This airline is a rip-off. They charge for everything 4 times more than other airlines. Very uncomfortable seats. Extremely poor service. I definitely refuse to fly with this airline again.
reviews.author: Roshana S

reviews.title: Terrible Experience with this airline.  Stay away!
reviews.text: Sun Country had to cancel our flight due to weather. This is a situation they could not control. That said, it is not the cancelation, it is how they handled the situation is our frustration. We were stranded in a foreign county and Sun Country did not provide any assistance to help us find lodging or ground transportation. It was a challenging situation to say the least. I had requested flight updates and communication via text. They sent and email, which I did not check before leaving our resort for the airport at 7:00 AM. We would have known the flight had been canceled we would have stayed at the current resort where we felt safe. It is Sun Country's customer service that we hav our issue with. The worst experience of my life. I strongly advice to spend the extra few hundred dollars and fly Delta or another airline with superior customer service. Learn from my mistake. Saving a few dollars was not worth this nightmare experience. Sun Country simply does not care. You will get lip service but zero execution.
reviews.author: troybrown64

reviews.title: Worst Customer Service Ever and Flight was Terrible!
reviews.text: You pay for what you get, Suncountry employees some of the most rude people. 3 experiences later on suncountry and I will never fly them again. I fly weekly for work on other airlines and SunCountry is by far the worst airline to fly. Reasons for each experience: 1 - Paid for a seat for me and my 3 kids, they seated my 3, 5, and 6 year old in different rows away from me after I had paid. Lady at checkin said nothing she could do and told me to leave with my kids. I asked how they could put a 3 year old in a row by themselves and she told me they weren't, i was by boarding the plane, I could choose just not to go. Are you kidding me? She was incredibly rude. We had to ask people to move for us. 2 - they don't check your documents before you fly, we had an issue in customs and suncountry removed one of us from the return flight without telling us and we had to purchase a new seat day of when we found out he didn't have a flight. There was no support from suncountry regarding our issues with a passport. They just pulled us from the return flight, no notification. 3 - I paid for a window seat on my flight, $30 for the window seat. I didnt have a window, i called and asked about it and they said they can't guarantee window seats so why would I pay $30 for it!? 4 - Do not check a bag with Suncountry, do carry on if you can. Sun country does not pay for the baggage staff at airports so they only get staff when they have availability from other airlines. So you will wait 2+ hours for baggage at times. Not fun when you are returning home on an evening flight and then have to wait there for another 2 hours for your bags. Again, do not recommend Suncountry to anyone. It isnt worth the savings from choosing the cheapest airlines.
reviews.author: Stephanie L

reviews.title: Stranded with no recourse
reviews.text: A blizzard prevented us from catching our Delta flight home to Minneapolis. They were going to rebook us, but we found a better time and location for our flight through Suncountry. Luckily they had three tickets available! We purchased those tickets with priority, seating and bags. We got our confirmation. We went to the airport, dropped off our rental car, canceled our hotel, and as we got to the front of the check-in line, they told us there were no seats and they had overbooked. They didn’t even try to rebook us for another five days. They offered us nothing. They told us we were too late. Ultimately they backpedaled and let one of our party get on the plane. So clearly we weren’t that late. I still haven’t seen my refund or any compensation for the fact that I relied on that plane, I needed to book yet another hotel, another airline, and I am still stuck in Florida with my eight year old. I can’t believe they bumped us for someone who paid more which is clearly what they did – and they never told me until it was too late and all of our plans were gutted. Suncountry is a total nightmare, and I will never make the mistake of venturing away from a reliable carrier.
reviews.author: Liz N

reviews.title: Passenger
reviews.text: Sun County canceled my flight last minute and offered absolutely no support or help. I was stranded at the airport without adequate finances to afford accommodation and they offered nothing to help. I spoke with a supervisor who was so rude in the phone and acted like my hardships were somehow annoying to him. Terrible, unethical airline. Do not waste your hard earned money on such terrible service.
reviews.author: Ann R

reviews.title: re-First class no thank you
reviews.text: Hi, I flew back on Sunday March the 5th from Azusa, CA. I was on my own and am a vulnerable adult. While I had a tremendous time visiting my dad in Arizona, I will never again travel Sun Country. Now I am an overweight adult male and your first class seats were half the size of the office chair I am sitting on now. On top of things, upon landing at msp around 11:48pm Sunday night, I did not get home until 2:45am! We were kept on the tarmac as the pilot "negotiated with optics" for a gate. Such a disgrace. I was without proper medication for my diabetes and on top of it you all lost my checked bag. Mind you I did get it back, but still. For those who have disabilities do not travel this airline.
reviews.author: Jesse B

reviews.title: Lost luggage
reviews.text: This is a horrible horrible horrible airline, try and get ahold of anyone!...my luggage never made it on the plane had no luggage for my 4 day trip it's been 4 months and still no contact...take a carry on only with this airline...or better yet book with another airline.
reviews.author: Jennifer P

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: This was a terrible experience. Our flight was scheduled for 10:10 AM and has slowly been getting delayed all morning. Our flight was delayed all the way until 1:30 and we were guaranteed it would not be delayed anymore. This was a lie because it kept getting delayed and jumped up to 6:35 meaning we would get there at around midnight. Do not fly with Sun Country.
reviews.author: Chloe T

reviews.title: Cancellation no explanation & Deplaned for 3 Hours - Never again.
reviews.text: I have been a loyal Sun Country customer for many years. I have always found (and still do) the crew to be very kind and hardworking. However, the management and customer service is severely lacking impacting customers and the flight crew. Last February we traveled to Minneapolis and got a hotel for our early morning flight. After driving 5 hours to airport, I noticed an email at 9pm saying that our flight the following morning was cancelled. I understand that things happen beyond control, but no help was offered to help customers find alternative travel nor was any compensation given. T This February I was sure my last experience was just a fluke and decided to try again. We boarded our plane in FLL to sit on it for an hour while we waited for mechanic to look at the AC that was not working. We were then deplaned and told nothing and not once updated for 3 hours. We then got back on the plane. They explained that they were going to test the AC unit by turning the engines fully on at the gate. While the AC did not work and the plane shutdown causing panic. 30 minutes later we were told that we were just going to go for it. My toddler son was terrified of the entire experience. A $50 voucher in my 4 year old son's name is not compensation because I will never put him on another Sun County flight. I tried to reach out to customer service and was told policy is policy. Never again, Sun Country.
reviews.author: astroud09

reviews.title: Nightmare
reviews.text: I am not joking when I say this is singularly one of the worst experiences I had - my flight was delayed by 3 hours and when we de-planed, I waited an hour and a half for my checked bag. The staff kept saying “we don’t have enough staff to unload bags”….I mean, I get this is a budget airline but this is atrocious. I should have been home at 11pm and instead I’m typing this review at 3am in the morning while waiting for my Uber. Please fix your ground operations, Sun Country!
reviews.author: Pascal S

reviews.title: Absolute trash
reviews.text: If you like waiting over an hour to get off the plane after landing and to get your luggage this is the perfect airline for you. They will take their time doing absolutely everything so don’t ever expect to be able to get anywhere near your estimated time of arrival. With baggage fee’s it’s barely cheaper than delta. Not worth it.
reviews.author: Tvc

reviews.title: The new spirit airline
reviews.text: I have been behind sun country for my while life this was an absolute disaster. A 2 year old got put by her self. Oh and then moved into the same seat as her uncle. But yet we paid for a seat for her. Wow is all I have to say delta I guess from now on.
reviews.author: Tim H

reviews.title: Not the Airline it Once Was😞
reviews.text: Sun Country Airlines was once our first choice for our trips. After our recent experience we will avoid. The flight done the crew were extremely rude. The flight home the crew was nice, but were not restocked to offer much inflight service. Insufficient beverages and for purchase snacks. Make sure to bring your own. The stop in San Juan was a fiasco. We also found the cost of the flights to be extremely high. Such a shame to see this happen to what was once a great airline.
reviews.author: Diane

reviews.title: Direct flight from EAU to RSW
reviews.text: Sat in 2A and 2B. Worth the cost of the seats. More leg room, more recline, a snack of dots pretzels and one free alcoholic beverage. Easy airports to fly in and out of. On the way back sat in 14A and 14B the exit row. Again, lots of legroom but no recline. No free snack. The in-air entertainment did not work with our devices but seemed like others got it to work. Good flights both ways. Suncountry does not have an APP.
reviews.author: sglyons

reviews.title: Was Planning On Flying Sun Country
reviews.text: I was just sitting here making my reservations for my Bday trip in May and I was going to book this Airline, but I have to say I WILL NOT be booking this Airline now smh. I have never in my life essn so many NEGATIVE reviews for an airline before not even Frontier or Sunjet. This iis startling and if I'm deterd just by the reviews I can only Imagine what thousands of other ppl are thinking as well. I would suggest Sun Country clean it up because if I'm detered and I'm booking for 6ppl roundtrip then can u imagine how much money you guys are losing just off of reviews. That Is Not Good
reviews.author: Michelle J

reviews.title: Sun County Flight Delayed 10+ hours!
reviews.text: While we were checking out bags at around 3:35Am for our departing at 6:45 Am we received and E-mail at 3:46 Am saying our flight was delayed until 4:15Pm which BTW did not take off until about 5:07Pm because the plane had to be de-iced. No one told us at check in out flight was delayed. No communication whatsoever. Now our bags are checked and being held hostage until we arrive in Florida at 11:07 Pm. We lost our rental car, we had to call family to drive 2.5 hours to come pick us up late at night, oh BTW he's 76 years old. We missed an entire day and stupid us paid the extra money for flight insurance which covered nothing. OH WOWEE, they gave us a $100 voucher because they had no crew to fly on out trip. The bigger seats were filthy with trash on the floor and in the back of the seat pockets and the crew was rude. The last time we used Sun Country we were delayed for over 7 hours. SHAME ON YOU SUN COUNTRY, NEVER AGAIN!!!
reviews.author: Dennis C
